definition: Legal Entity Identifier of the bank (20 characters).
formula: as reported; old LEIs mapped to the current LEI
use: Key of the panel; bank identity across years.
caution: LEIs change over time: the crosswalk of TR_Metadata is applied.

definition: Name of the bank.
use: Readable labels in tables and charts.
caution: Taken from the latest edition available.

definition: ISO code of the country of the bank (NSA).
use: Filtering and aggregation by country; selects the regulatory profile (EU or BNM).
caution: Not an input of the models.

definition: Reference quarter (e.g. 2020Q1 for 202003).
formula: Period converted to a calendar quarter
use: Time axis; label horizon and trends are computed on it.
caution: Editions cover only some quarters; gaps are not filled.

definition: Calendar year of the quarter.
use: Aggregation by year; time split.

definition: Edition (folder year_XXXX) the row comes from.
use: Traceability; the latest edition wins on duplicates.

definition: Whether the bank reports FINREP (accounting) data.
formula: False if the value starts with No
use: Explains structural missing values (assets, equity, profit, loans, NPL).
caution: 13 banks are flagged in the 2020 edition.

definition: Common Equity Tier 1 capital after deductions and transitional adjustments.
use: Numerator of the CET1 ratio; consistency check.
caution: Unit not stated in the files received; verify in the guide.

definition: Additional Tier 1 capital.
use: Consistency check: Tier 1 = CET1 + AT1.

definition: Tier 1 capital (transitional).
use: Numerator of the Tier 1 ratio.

definition: Tier 2 capital.
use: Total capital = Tier 1 + Tier 2.

definition: Total risk exposure amount (risk-weighted assets).
use: Denominator of all capital ratios; proxy of balance-sheet size and risk.
caution: Equals item 2021107 in the 2020 files.

definition: CET1 capital / risk exposure amount, transitional definition.
use: Main solvency indicator: feature of the models, input of the rule benchmark (alert level 7%), basis of event E1.
caution: Stored as a fraction, not as a percentage.

definition: Tier 1 capital / risk exposure amount.
use: Feature; rule benchmark (alert level 8.5%); event E1.
caution: Highly correlated with CET1 ratio: check VIF for logistic regression.

definition: Total own funds / risk exposure amount.
use: Feature; rule benchmark (alert level 10.5%); event E1.
caution: Nested with the other two ratios.

definition: CET1 ratio without transitional arrangements.
use: Sensitivity analysis; shows the effect of transitional rules.
caution: Not used as primary feature.

definition: Tier 1 capital (transitional) / total leverage exposure.
use: Feature that does not depend on risk weights; complements the risk-based ratios.
caution: Very high for some specialised banks; in 2020 no binding minimum applied in the EU.

definition: Total leverage ratio exposure measure.
use: Denominator of the leverage ratio.

definition: Total assets (accounting).
use: Size control; denominator checks.
caution: Missing for banks without FINREP.

definition: Total accounting equity.
use: Denominator of ROE.
caution: Item missing in the SDD: resolved by exact label.

definition: Profit or loss for the year, cumulated since the start of the bank's financial year.
use: Numerator of ROE.
caution: Year-to-date: March holds one quarter, June two.

definition: Number of quarters included in the year-to-date profit.
use: Annualisation of the profit.
caution: Differs for banks with a non-December year end.

definition: Return on equity, annualised.
use: Earnings component of CAMELS; feature; one of the two families expected to rank first by SHAP (H5).
caution: Volatile for small equity; flagged outliers kept.

definition: Gross carrying amount of loans and advances (amortised cost and fair value).
source: tr_cre, item 2020603, all breakdown dimensions at 0, Perf_Status 0
use: Denominator of the NPL ratio; base of loan growth.
caution: 123 of 135 banks report the NPE template.

definition: Gross carrying amount of non-performing loans and advances.
use: Numerator of the NPL ratio.

definition: Stage 3 loans as reported in the NPE template.
use: Cross-check with the Assets template.
caution: Differs from tr_oth for 9 of 122 bank-quarters in 2020.

definition: Non-performing loans / total loans.
use: Asset-quality feature; basis of event E3.
caution: Up to 47% for Greek banks in 2020; heavy right tail.

definition: Share of IFRS 9 Stage 2 loans in loans at amortised cost.
use: Early signal of deterioration before loans become non-performing.
caution: Only for banks reporting FINREP.

definition: Stage 3 loans as reported in the Assets template.
use: Cross-check with npe_stage3.

definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of loans to non-financial corporations across NACE sectors.
formula: sum over sectors of (share of sector)^2
use: Proxy of sectoral concentration (the exposure per client is not public).
caution: 1 means a single sector; undefined without loans.

definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of sovereign exposures across issuer countries.
use: Proxy of sovereign concentration.
caution: Not computed yet: tr_sov not provided.

definition: Change of the NPL ratio versus the previous quarter.
use: Trend feature tested in H3.
caution: Empty unless the previous quarter exists.

definition: Quarterly growth of gross loans.
use: Trend feature tested in H3 (credit growth).
caution: Empty unless the previous quarter exists.

definition: Annual growth of gross loans.
use: Trend feature tested in H3.
caution: Needs editions covering four quarters earlier.

definition: Change of the CET1 ratio versus the previous quarter.
use: Capital trend; basis of event E2.

definition: Distance of the CET1 ratio from the E1 alert level.
use: Shows how far a bank is from event E1; used to tune the margin m of benchmark R1.
caution: Alert levels are uniform, not bank-specific.

definition: Distance of the Tier 1 ratio from its alert level.
use: Same use as above.

definition: Distance of the total capital ratio from its alert level.
use: Same use as above.

definition: Smallest of the three headrooms.
use: Single measure of proximity to a breach; negative means a breach.

definition: Liquidity coverage ratio.
use: Liquidity component of CAMELS.
caution: Not present in the 2020 edition.

definition: All three capital ratios are at or above their alert levels at t.
use: Defines the prediction sample (new breaches only).

definition: 1 if a breach of an alert level occurs in the next 4 quarters; 0 if the whole horizon is observed without breach; missing otherwise.
use: Target of the supervised models and of the rule benchmark comparison.
caution: Missing when the horizon is not fully observed.
